SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, COUNT(*) AS entries, COUNT(*) - (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId)) AS difference_from_average
FROM constructorResults AS cr
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country
HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId))
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, cr.raceId
LIMIT 10
